critical.title: Incorrect Canonical URLs
critical.description: 8 pages have canonical URLs pointing elsewhere
critical.impact: Wrong canonicals tell Google to index a different page, causing these pages not to rank.
critical.recommendation: Set canonical URLs to self-reference unless intentionally consolidating duplicate content

critical.title: Extremely Thin Content
critical.impact: Pages with under 100 words provide minimal value and may be penalized by Google.
critical.recommendation: Either add substantial content (300+ words) or consider noindexing these pages
critical.how_to_fix: Consolidate with other pages or create comprehensive standalone content

high.title: Duplicate Title Tags
high.impact: Duplicate titles confuse search engines about which page to rank, causing internal competition.
affected_pages: https://brutt.in → "Custom Handcrafted Art & Personalized Gifts | Brutt"
https://brutt.in/auth?view=signin → "Brutt - Custom Handcrafted Art & Personalized Gifts | Handmade in India"
https://brutt.in/auth?view=signup → "Brutt - Custom Handcrafted Art & Personalized Gifts | Handmade in India"
https://brutt.in/creations → "Brutt - Custom Handcrafted Art & Personalized Gifts | Handmade in India"
https://brutt.in/ → "Custom Handcrafted Art & Personalized Gifts | Brutt"
https://brutt.in/terms → "Brutt - Custom Handcrafted Art & Personalized Gifts | Handmade in India"
https://brutt.in/privacy-policy → "Brutt - Custom Handcrafted Art & Personalized Gifts | Handmade in India"
high.recommendation: Create unique title tags for each page that reflect its specific content
high.how_to_fix: Include page-specific keywords and differentiate similar pages

high.title: Thin Content Pages
high.impact: Thin content pages rarely rank well. Google favors comprehensive, valuable content.
high.recommendation: Expand content to at least 300 words, ideally 600-1000+ for competitive topics
high.how_to_fix: Add detailed explanations, examples, FAQs, and relevant supporting information

medium.title: Duplicate Meta Descriptions
medium.impact: Duplicate descriptions reduce uniqueness and may lower click-through rates from search results.
medium.recommendation: Write unique meta descriptions that accurately reflect each page's content
medium.how_to_fix: Highlight what makes each page unique and include relevant keywords naturally

medium.title: Title Tags Too Long
medium.description: 7 pages have title tags longer than 60 characters
medium.impact: Long titles get truncated in search results, potentially cutting off important keywords.
medium.recommendation: Shorten titles to 50-60 characters to prevent truncation
medium.how_to_fix: Put most important keywords first, remove filler words

medium.title: URLs with Query Parameters
medium.description: 2 pages have query parameters in URLs
medium.impact: URLs with parameters can create duplicate content and are less user-friendly.
medium.recommendation: Use clean URLs without parameters, or ensure proper canonical tags
medium.how_to_fix: Convert /page?id=123 to /page/product-name or use URL rewriting

low.title: H1 and Title Tag Mismatch
low.description: 10 pages have unrelated H1 and title tags
low.impact: Mismatched H1 and titles can create confusion about page topic and dilute keyword focus.
affected_pages: https://brutt.in → H1: "Gifts That HoldMemories" | Title: "Custom Handcrafted Art & Personalized Gifts | Brutt"
https://brutt.in/auth?view=signin → H1: "Sign in to your Account" | Title: "Brutt - Custom Handcrafted Art & Personalized Gifts | Handmade in India"
https://brutt.in/work-with-us → H1: "Share Your Art.Reach the World." | Title: "Work With Us - Become a Brutt Partner Artist | Turn Your Passion into Profit"
https://brutt.in/auth?view=signup → H1: "Create your Account" | Title: "Brutt - Custom Handcrafted Art & Personalized Gifts | Handmade in India"
https://brutt.in/creations → H1: "404" | Title: "Brutt - Custom Handcrafted Art & Personalized Gifts | Handmade in India"
low.recommendation: Align H1 and title tags to reinforce primary keyword and topic
low.how_to_fix: Use similar keywords and phrasing in both H1 and title, but vary slightly for search diversity

low.title: H1 Tags Too Short
low.description: 5 pages have H1 tags shorter than 20 characters
low.impact: Very short H1s may not adequately describe the page content or include target keywords.
low.recommendation: Expand H1 tags to 20-70 characters with clear, keyword-rich descriptions
low.how_to_fix: Include primary keyword and clear topic description
